title: Jom Nulal Yanaande
intro: Yonta peewal neldaama ngam ardude e leñol majjungol e tooñanngeeji ɗi meeɗaa yiyeede. Oo nulaaɗo dariima, ina rokka jeertinaango tiiɗngo e fenaande luulndiinde doosgal tago. Ko wonaa eeraango tiiɗngo, renndo ngoo ɓeydii luggiɗde e niɓɓere, waɗti dingiral ngam hiisaade diine mo nanndaani e goɗɗo. Mbele aɗa waawi anndude oo maccuɗo Alla dariiɗo?
clues: Miin ko mi banndi annabi mawɗo goɗɗo, mi eggii e makko, mi acci leydi amen.
Mi neldaama e leñol ngol bonannde mum alaa ko nanndi heen, bonannde nde hay tagoore wootere waɗaani hade mum en.
Galle am oo feccii; tergal galle ɓadiiɗo ina wondi e keefeerɓe e sirlu.
Maleykaaji, e mbaadi sukaaɓe jom en gite, ngari e galle am ko hoɓɓe, ina ngaddana mi mette mawɗe ngam kisal maɓɓe.
Mi hokkii ɓiɓɓe am rewɓe dewgal e leñol am ngam yiɗde ruttaade e golle maɓɓe hersiniiɗe.
Leñol am halkaama e wullaango kulɓiniingo e toɓo kaaƴe ɓuuɓɗe, miin e ɓesngu am, so wonaa gooto, min ndañii e yaltude e maayde jamma.

identity.label: Hol ko ngonmi?
options: Annabi Shu'ayb
Annabi Saalihu
Annabi Luut
Annabi Huudu
Annabi Nuuhu

trial.label: Hol ko wonnoo ñaawoore am adannde?
options: Waɗde laamɗo jom doole en hoto ɓuuɓnu mi e yiite.
Haɓde e kaaɗdi banndiraaɓe am e werlaade e nder ɓunndu.
Haɓde e leñol ngol waɗata ko fenaande nde meeɗaa yiyeede.
Ardude leñol am e maccungaagu Firawna jom doole.
Mahde laana mawka ngam hisnude goonɗinɓe e ilam mawɗam.
trial.answer: Haɓde e leñol ngol waɗata ko fenaande nde meeɗaa yiyeede.

location.label: Hol ko wonnoo nokku ɗo Mission am woni ɗoo?
options: Wuro ngo Madiyan
Wuro ɓooyngo wiyeteengo Iram
Leydi Misra e gardagol Firaawna
Ngam wuro Sodoma e Gomoora
Ngalluure Niniwe

outcome.label: Hol ko woni batte mum?
options: Wurooji ɗii njippiima, ɗi njippiima e kaaƴe ɓutte.
Leñol am leydi ɓuuɓtii ɗum wondude e gardiiɗo mum en alɗuɗo.
Henndu bonndu halki yimɓe am jemmaaji joweeɗiɗi e nyalɗe joweetati.
Leñol am tampii e ñawuuji hono mborosaaji, mborosaaji e paabi.
Liɗɗi mawɗi ɓuuɓtii kam caggal nde njoofnu-mi golle am.
outcome.answer: Wurooji ɗii njippiima, ɗi njippiima e kaaƴe ɗe loope ɓuuɓɗe.

arabic: فَلَمَّا جَآءَ أَمْرُنَا جَعَلْنَا عَـٰلِيَهَا سَافِلَهَا وَأَمْطَرْنَا عَلَيْهَا حِجَارَةًۭ مِّن سِجِّيلٍۢ مَّنضُودٍۢ
verse: So when Our command came, We made the highest part [of the city] its lowest and rained upon them stones of layered hard clay, [which were] (11:82)
